### Pitch

- Name: Earthquake armour tank
- Why pick it: Stacked armour shrugs off the hits that kill most melee builds.
- How it clears: Stand in the pack and quake.
- Bosses: Face-tank and quake between hits.
- Needs: armour on every slot; online by act 3; no respec; moderate
- The catch: Armour takes the slots that would add damage.
- Under-played (judgment): armour stacking on a quake build
- Playstyle: melee, few-buttons, tanky
